en-US.summary: Chat with ChatGPT through your Alexa device
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask chat conversation to tell me a joke
Alexa, ask chat conversation what is the weather like
en-US.name: ChatGPT Conversation
en-US.description: Have natural conversations with ChatGPT through your Alexa device. Ask questions, get information, or just chat about anything you'd like. The skill maintains conversation context, so you can have multi-turn dialogues just like you would with the ChatGPT interface.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Please use invocation name 'chat conversation' and ask various questions to test the ChatGPT integration.
